entriesBand.title: Entries
entriesBand.empty: No entries yet for this step.

unknownMethod.body: This entry was created by a method this build doesn't recognize ("{{methodId}}"). It can be reordered, hidden or removed, but not opened.

workspace.jumpAdvisory: Step {{step}} has no entries yet — you can still work on it out of order.

readiness.s1: The gap isn't quantified yet — add a number, a unit, and a baseline period.
readiness.s2NoDataEntry: This step is opinion only — add at least one data-based entry (Pareto, trend, check sheet, or stratification).
readiness.s2NoPointOfCause: No point of cause has been nominated yet.
readiness.s3: Not every SMART target field is filled in yet (metric, baseline, target, unit, due date).
readiness.s4: No root cause is verified yet — mark a hypothesis confirmed, or confirm a root cause in the why-why tree.
readiness.s5NoVerifiedRootCause: At least one countermeasure isn't linked to a verified root cause.
readiness.s5UnjustifiedHierarchy: A countermeasure sits at the weakest error-proofing level (procedure/training) with no documented reason.
readiness.s6: At least one action has no owner or no due date.
readiness.s7: A result is recorded but the process confirmation (sustainment audit) is empty.
readiness.s8NoDocumentUpdated: No document has been marked updated.

traceability.orphanLine: Step {{step}} — "{{title}}" points at an entry that no longer exists ({{role}}).
traceability.empty: No traceability chains are recorded yet — link a root cause, a countermeasure, or an action to a step behind it to start one.
traceability.standardGapNote: Steps 7 and 8 aren't linked into this chain yet — today's reference model traces problem → root cause → countermeasure → action, not as far as the standardization step.

genericText.name: Free text
genericText.useWhen: Use this when no dedicated method fits yet — a plain note.

pareto.name: Pareto chart
pareto.useWhen: Use this to find the vital few causes carrying most of the effect — the 80/20 view.

fiveWhy.name: 5 Why
fiveWhy.useWhen: Use this for a straightforward, linear chain of causality — Step 4 only.

threeLeggedFiveWhy.name: 3-Legged 5 Why
threeLeggedFiveWhy.useWhen: Use this for customer complaints — the automotive default. Tests occurrence, detection and the systemic/management gap in parallel.

smartTarget.name: SMART target card
smartTarget.useWhen: Use this for Step 3 — the mandatory target that distinguishes an 8-step problem from a 7-step one.

isIsNot.name: Is / Is-Not
isIsNot.useWhen: Use this to bound the problem precisely — what it is versus what it could be but isn't, by where, when and extent.

trend.name: Trend / run chart
trend.useWhen: Use this to see whether the metric is actually moving over time, against a target and known events.

fiveG5N1K.name: 5G + 5N1K
fiveG5N1K.useWhen: Use this as the default way to clarify a problem — go see the actual place, thing and facts, then answer what/where/how/when/how much/who.

fishbone.name: Fishbone (Ishikawa)
fishbone.useWhen: Use this to map candidate root causes by category before testing them — Step 4 only.

gapStatement.name: Gap statement
gapStatement.useWhen: Use this to state the problem as the distance between the ideal and actual condition.

fiveW2H.name: 5W2H
fiveW2H.useWhen: Use this as a broad problem-clarification checklist covering what, where, when, who, which, how and how much.

problemTypeClassifier.name: Problem type classifier
problemTypeClassifier.useWhen: Use this to classify the problem before choosing a method — a standard that was never met, a standard worth raising, or performance that varies.

tpmLossTaxonomy.name: TPM loss taxonomy
tpmLossTaxonomy.useWhen: Use this to tag which company-reported loss categories this problem affects, and how severely.

vocComplaint.name: VOC / complaint record
vocComplaint.useWhen: Use this to log customer complaints behind this problem — one row per claim.

containmentIca.name: Containment / ICA
containmentIca.useWhen: Use this to log interim containment actions while the root cause is still being worked — automotive standard.

stratificationMatrix.name: Stratification matrix
stratificationMatrix.useWhen: Use this to break occurrences down by line, shift, machine, cavity, operator, supplier, date or product — before guessing at a cause.

checkSheet.name: Check sheet
checkSheet.useWhen: Use this as a tally sheet for counting how often each defect type occurs.

processFlowSipoc.name: Process flow / SIPOC
processFlowSipoc.useWhen: Use this to map the process — Supplier, Input, Process, Output, Customer — one row per step.

msaGageRr.name: MSA / Gage R&R note
msaGageRr.useWhen: Use this to record whether the measurement system itself is trustworthy before trusting the data it produced.

pointOfCause.name: Point of cause
pointOfCause.useWhen: Use this to nominate where in the process the problem first becomes observable — the mandatory output of Step 2.

whyWhyTree.name: Why-Why logic tree
whyWhyTree.useWhen: Use this when a why has more than one credible answer and a linear 5-Why chain would force you to drop one.

faultTree.name: Fault tree (FTA)
faultTree.useWhen: Use this when several conditions must coincide (AND) or any one suffices (OR) for the failure to occur.

causeEffectMatrix.name: Cause & effect (X-Y) matrix
causeEffectMatrix.useWhen: Use this to rank process inputs by how strongly they drive the outputs the customer cares about.

pfmeaLinkage.name: PFMEA linkage
pfmeaLinkage.useWhen: Use this to tie the failure mode under analysis to its PFMEA line and its current O/D ratings.

hypothesisVerification.name: Hypothesis verification table
hypothesisVerification.useWhen: Use this to prove or reject each candidate cause with evidence — a cause becomes a root cause only when confirmed.

pointOfCause.label: Point of cause verified
pointOfCause.empty: No point of cause linked yet.

comparativeAnalysis.name: Comparative analysis
comparativeAnalysis.useWhen: Use this to compare a good case against a bad one — good part vs bad part, good line vs bad line.

countermeasure.name: Countermeasure
countermeasure.useWhen: Use this for one countermeasure, linked to the verified root causes it addresses.
countermeasure.priorityScoreUnscored: Priority score: fill in Impact/Cost/Duration to compute

rootCause.label: Root causes addressed
rootCause.empty: No root cause linked yet — a countermeasure with no root cause is a guess.

actionItem.name: Action
actionItem.useWhen: Use this for one implementation action — who does what, by when, and what proves it was done.

icaPcaTransition.name: ICA → PCA transition
icaPcaTransition.useWhen: Use this to track when an interim containment action can come off, and whether it actually did.

categoryBreakdown.name: Category breakdown (5M)
categoryBreakdown.useWhen: Use this in Step 2 to sort what you're seeing by category — Man, Machine, Material, Method, Measurement — sub-problems and their effects. This is stratification, not root-cause analysis; save "why" for Step 4's Fishbone and 5-Why.

distributionChart.name: Histogram / scatter / box plot
distributionChart.useWhen: Use this to see the shape of the data itself — spread, skew, outliers — before jumping to a cause.

errorProofingHierarchy.name: Error-proofing hierarchy
errorProofingHierarchy.useWhen: Use this to rate one countermeasure's strength on the Eliminate → Procedure/Training scale, and to nudge yourself toward a stronger fix.

impactEffortMatrix.name: Impact / effort matrix
impactEffortMatrix.useWhen: Use this to sort candidate countermeasures into quick wins, major projects, fill-ins and thankless tasks.

weightedDecisionMatrix.name: Weighted decision matrix (Pugh)
weightedDecisionMatrix.useWhen: Use this to compare countermeasure options objectively against weighted criteria instead of by gut feel.

sideEffectRiskAssessment.name: Side-effect / risk assessment
sideEffectRiskAssessment.useWhen: Use this to record what the countermeasure itself could break, before it ships.

trialPlan.name: Trial plan
trialPlan.useWhen: Use this to define how a countermeasure will be piloted before full rollout — scope, duration, sample and pass/fail line.

costApproval.name: Cost & approval
costApproval.useWhen: Use this to record what a countermeasure costs and who signed off on it.

trialResultLog.name: Trial result log
trialResultLog.useWhen: Use this to log what actually happened during the trial, one entry per observation.

trainingCommunicationRecord.name: Training & communication record
trainingCommunicationRecord.useWhen: Use this to record who was trained or informed, how, and who acknowledged it.

implementationIssuesLog.name: Implementation issues log
implementationIssuesLog.useWhen: Use this to record problems hit while rolling out a countermeasure, and how each was resolved.

fiveN1K.name: 5N1K strip
fiveN1K.useWhen: Use this for Step 1's mandatory 5N1K panel — What, why, how, who, when, where, in the reference image's own order.

problemImpact.name: Problem impact (cost)
problemImpact.useWhen: Use this to show the problem's financial impact as a Pareto chart plus monthly/yearly loss figures — Step 1's optional add-on.

gembaObservationLog.name: Gemba observation log
gembaObservationLog.useWhen: Use this to record what you saw on the shop floor — date, place, observer and a photo.

beforeAfterPhotos.name: Before / after photos
beforeAfterPhotos.useWhen: Use this to show a countermeasure's physical result — a before photo and an after photo, side by side.
beforeAfterPhotos.hint: Add the before and after photos below — this method has no fields of its own.

defectPhotoBoard.name: Defect photo board
defectPhotoBoard.useWhen: Use this to mark up a defect photo directly — arrows, circles and callouts pointing at exactly what's wrong.
defectPhotoBoard.hint: Add a photo below, then use Annotate to mark up the defect — this method has no fields of its own.

spaghettiDiagram.name: Spaghetti diagram
spaghettiDiagram.useWhen: Use this to trace material or people flow over a floor-plan photo — draw the actual path taken.
spaghettiDiagram.hint: Add a floor-plan photo below, then use Annotate to trace the flow — this method has no fields of its own.

valueStreamMap.name: Value stream map
valueStreamMap.useWhen: Use this to attach a value stream map — a whiteboard capture or a scan — and mark up the bottlenecks.
valueStreamMap.hint: Add a photo below, then use Annotate to mark it up — this method has no fields of its own.

kpiStrip.name: KPI strip
kpiStrip.useWhen: Use this for Step 7's KPI tracking tiles — baseline, target and actual side by side, one per metric.

sustainmentAudit.name: Sustainment audit
sustainmentAudit.useWhen: Use this to log periodic/recurring audits that confirm a countermeasure is still holding, distinct from a one-off check sheet.

documentUpdatesTracker.name: Document updates tracker
documentUpdatesTracker.useWhen: Use this to track which controlled documents need updating after this problem — PFMEA, Control Plan, work instructions and the rest, tracked separately.

yokotenTracker.name: Yokoten (horizontal spread) tracker
yokotenTracker.useWhen: Use this to track where else this problem could apply, and whether the fix has actually spread there.

lessonsLearned.name: Lessons learned
lessonsLearned.useWhen: Use this to close the problem out with a structured retrospective — what worked, what to reuse, what to avoid next time.

statisticalConfirmation.name: Statistical confirmation
statisticalConfirmation.useWhen: Use this to record capability (Cp/Cpk), a p-chart summary and the observed defect rate after the countermeasure was implemented.

realizedCostBenefit.name: Realized cost-benefit
realizedCostBenefit.useWhen: Use this to record what the countermeasure actually cost and delivered, once results are in.

resultVerdict.name: Result verdict
resultVerdict.useWhen: Use this to record whether the target was met, and to open a new analysis round if it wasn't.

sustainPlan.name: Sustain plan
sustainPlan.useWhen: Use this to define how the fix will keep being checked after this project closes — audit type, frequency, owner, LPA linkage.

openItemsNextProblem.name: Open items / next problem
openItemsNextProblem.useWhen: Use this to log anything left unresolved, or the next problem this project surfaced.
